title: 6 races paying 5 places today, and our tip for every extra place race
content:
Betfred is paying 5 places instead of 4 on six races today, three at Leicester and three at Punchestown, and QuinnBet matches it on three of them. Add two races at Wolverhampton this evening and that is 8 extra place races, with our tip for every one.

👉 See Betfred’s extra place races and view T&Cs here

Today’s extra place races

Time Course Places (1/5 odds) Paying Runners Our tip
15:20 Punchestown 5 Betfred, QuinnBet 18 LIVE TO LAUGH (7/2)
15:39 Leicester 5 Betfred, QuinnBet 18 BAY BREEZE (forecast 10/1)
16:30 Punchestown 5 Betfred 18 POETIC FOCUS (6/1)
16:47 Leicester 5 Betfred, QuinnBet 18 HUNGARIAN (forecast 10/1)
17:07 Punchestown 5 Betfred 18 LAS BRISAS BOY (7/1)
17:17 Leicester 5 Betfred 17 NEW OBJECTIVE (forecast 6/1)
19:30 Wolverhampton 4 Betfred 12 NEPTUNE LEGEND (forecast 6/1)
20:00 Wolverhampton 4 QuinnBet 11 COXY’S STAR (forecast 7/2)

Tips from our Dark Horses (British races) and Irish racing tips (Punchestown). Prices were correct when our tips were published. Runners from this morning’s racecards.

Where the extra place helps most

BAY BREEZE in the 15:39 at Leicester has the biggest gap on our model today: forecast at 10/1, against our tissue price of 4.72. David Allan rides for Tim Easterby, and both Betfred and QuinnBet pay 5 places in an 18-runner field. That is the kind of race where a 10/1 shot only needs to sneak into fifth for the place part to pay.

HUNGARIAN (16:47 Leicester) is another 10/1 shot in a 5-place race with both bookies.

A word on runners: the 19:30 at Wolverhampton has exactly 12 runners, the minimum for 4 places at Betfred. Betfred also listed the 20:00 at Wolverhampton, but it has only 11 runners, so Betfred’s standard place terms apply there; QuinnBet still lists it as an extra place race. Check the place terms before you bet.

Today’s money back race is the 13:24 at Leicester.

For every partner’s extra place races, see our extra places page.

How it works

  1. Back your horse each way in one of the races above.
  2. If it finishes in one of the paid places, including the extra one, the place part pays out at 1/5 odds.

Key terms

  • New and existing verified customers. Each way singles and each way multiples only. Antepost bets do not count.
  • At Betfred, 4 places needs 12 or more runners, and 5 places needs 16 or more (below 16 it pays 4).
  • At QuinnBet, each way singles or accumulators placed before the off, one entry per customer.
  • Place terms can change if there are non-runners. Dead heat rules apply.
